rules.title: Standalone components
rules.text: Use standalone components and the inject() function.

rules.title: Signals for state
rules.text: Use signals for component state and prefer them over manual subscriptions.

rules.title: OnPush change detection
rules.text: Use OnPush change detection; it is the default in recent Angular versions, so set it explicitly on older ones.

rules.title: Clean up subscriptions
rules.text: Avoid manual subscribe where possible; use the async pipe or takeUntilDestroyed, passing a DestroyRef when called outside an injection context.

rules.title: Zoneless test pattern
rules.text: In zoneless tests, update state, await fixture.whenStable and then assert. Do not call fixture.detectChanges by hand.

rules.title: No new NgModules
rules.text: Create standalone components and directives. Do not introduce new NgModules even if nearby code uses them.
